sloka: ततः शरेण अभिहतो रामेण रण कर्कशः ।पपात सहसा वाली निकृत्तैव पादपः ॥४-१७-१॥
transliteration: tataḥ śareṇa abhihato rāmeṇa raṇa karkaśaḥ ।papāta sahasā vālī nikṛttaiva pādapaḥ ॥4-17-1॥

translations.english: A tyrant in war, Vali struck by4.54.24 Rama's arrow, collapsed instantaneously like a tree felled down.
